resolutionNotes: R74 is a high-level audit logging rule with 12 primary evidence items covering authentication, user activity, rent lifecycle, payment events, and audit log integrity. Multiple evidence items (E1, E8, E11) from Internal Audit Team highlight unresolved questions about identity resolution paths and source-of-truth models for audit visibility. These gaps should be resolved before test generation to clarify whether audit logs use direct identifiers or controlled lookup mechanisms.
